description: Discover the best hotels in Broadbeach, Australia. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Grand Opening: Gold Coast Two- & Three-Bedroom Luxury Apartments in Broadbeach with Resort-Style Pool & Parking
hotels.description: Be among the first to discover Broadbeach’s next sought-after address at Amaya Broadbeach, a brand-new collection of luxury residences on First Avenue, just 300 metres from the sand. With the beach, boutiques, restaurants, cafes and G:link light rail all close by, this is the Gold Coast at its most effortless. Inside, the residences deliver the space, style and privacy of a premium coastal home, with two- and three-bedroom layouts, open-plan living, designer kitchens, laundry facilities, private balconies and Broadbeach views. Floor-to-ceiling windows, marble finishes and timber accents create a refined, contemporary setting for couples, friends and families travelling together. Beyond your residence, considered facilities keep the experience feeling resort-like. Spend the afternoon in the heated magnesium pool and Jacuzzi, unwind in the state-of-the-art sauna or steam room, keep your routine on track in the fitness centre, then fire up the BBQ before heading out into Broadbeach’s entertainment scene.

hotels.title: Queensland: Broadbeach Resort-Style Residences with Onsite Pool & Spa
hotels.description: Set in the heart of Broadbeach, this contemporary stay places you moments from Kurrawa Beach and the dining precincts of Oracle Boulevard and The Oasis. Pacific Fair Shopping Centre and the Gold Coast Convention and Exhibition Centre are also close by, while the G:link light rail offers easy access to Surfers Paradise and Southport. Inside, expect sleek residences with kitchens, laundry facilities and private balconies. Guests can also make use of the outdoor pool, fitness centre and barbecue terrace, while nearby Mermaid Beach serves up relaxed cafés, seafood restaurants and late-night drinks.

hotels.title: Chic Broadbeach One-, Two- or Three- Bedroom Apartment Escape near Kurrawa Beach with Tranquil Outdoor Pool
hotels.description: Discover the glamour of the Gold Coast and indulge in a rejuvenating stay in the heart of Broadbeach. The hotel is a short stroll from the golden sands and surf-friendly waters of Kurrawa Beach and the vibrant dining scene of Oracle Boulevard. After days of exploration, take a dip in the outdoor pool or indulge in a workout at the fully equipped gym. Savour the spectacular skyline views from your private apartment balcony, or venture to the nearby Pacific Fair Shopping Centre.

hotels.title: Sky-High Oceanfront Broadbeach Apartment Stay with Two Serene Swimming Pools & In-House Theatre
hotels.description: Soar above the bustling heart of Broadbeach at this high-rise retreat, perfectly situated along the Gold Coast's pristine beaches. Soak up breathtaking ocean vistas from the comfort of your plush apartment, take a dip in the hotel's two sparkling pools or cosy up with a movie in the private theatre. Epic sunsets await at nearby Kurrawa and Mermaid Beach, while Queensland's largest shopping centre, Pacific Fair, is great for some retail therapy.

hotels.title: Sparkling Broadbeach Suite Stay in Shopping & Dining Precinct with Pool, Sauna & Outdoor Spa
hotels.description: Embrace the easy-going glamour of the Gold Coast with a stay at Peppers Broadbeach. In the heart of Broadbeach's dining and shopping scene, just moments from the golden sands of Kurrawa Beach, this relaxing retreat offers stunning ocean views from each of the private balconies extending from the modern suites and apartments. Spend your days exploring the best local eats, spend an afternoon wandering the hotel's gardens, or take a dip in the pool followed by a sauna session.

hotels.title: Gold Coast Long-Stay Luxury Apartments with A$500 Dining Credit & Pool
hotels.description: Set in the heart of Broadbeach, REMI Residences offers a rare private address on one of the Gold Coast's most coveted stretches of coastline. Expansive living and dining areas open onto deep balconies framing Pacific or parkland views, with bespoke kitchens and considered finishes throughout. Spend days on the golden sands just a short stroll from your door - swim, surf or watch the sunrise. Thrill-seekers are spoiled for choice with nearby world-class theme parks, including Warner Bros. Movie World, Dreamworld, Sea World and Wet'n'Wild. Rising 31 storeys above the coast, REMI is a bespoke collection of full-floor and oversized apartments designed in the spirit of a superyacht - honed natural stone, hand-selected timbers and bespoke detailing meet walls of glass and the endless blue of the Pacific. A 15-metre lap pool, fully equipped fitness centre, dedicated yoga studio, private treatment rooms, saunas and a residents' bar with alfresco terrace crown this sanctuary in the sky. Coastal indulgence, perfected.

hotels.title: Elevated Sofitel Gold Coast Luxury Moments from Broadbeach with Resort-Style Pool
hotels.description: Spoil yourself with French-inspired luxury at this iconic Gold Coast hotel, just steps from the golden sands of Broadbeach and set among buzzing restaurants and boutiques. The five-star Sofitel Gold Coast Broadbeach delivers outstanding service and a long list of state-of-the-art facilities including the sophisticated Room81 restaurant, two spectacular rooftop swimming pools - one heated - a stylish bar and plenty more.
